title: What does it mean? How do you say it?

sections.title: Words and sentences
sections.content: *Szó* is a word and *mondat* is a sentence. Ask what something means with *Mit jelent ez?* (What does this mean?). Ask how to say something with *Hogy mondják magyarul?* (How do you say it in Hungarian?). Learn *Hogy mondják magyarul?* as one phrase: the verb *mondják* is a form you will meet later, so only use it in this phrase.

sections.title: The language ending again
sections.content: The language in the phrase takes the same *-ul/-ül* ending: *Hogy mondják magyarul?* but *Hogy mondják németül?* The question word and the phrase never change.
